verdict.rationale: Snyk Code is a documented SAST product that scans source code in real time across IDE/CI/CD, shows source-to-sink data flow, and is runnable via `snyk code test` in the CLI; this directly matches finding vulnerability classes like injection/XSS. Community evidence mostly critiques SCA/dependency PR workflows and sales practices rather than SAST detection quality specifically, so it doesn't dispute the core capability.
